name: rain barrel
hint: A vessel hollowed from timber and placed beneath the eaves. Rain fills it in 12 hours.

log: You hollow a log with the axe and set it under the edge of the shelter.
Hour by hour the axe hollows the log.
The hollow trunk is set upright beneath the eaves, ready for the next shower.

start.label: set out
log: You place the barrel beneath the shelter's dripping edge.
The vessel stands ready where the next rain will gather.

collect.label: drink
log: You drink the cold rainwater accumulated in the wooden vessel.
The water carries a faint taste of timber, but it is fresh and welcome.
A useful store of rainwater is now at your disposal.
